problem: The number $99^{88} \div 1001$ is an integer. Compute the sum of its prime factors.
solution: Observe $99^{88} = 27^6 - 16^6 = (27^2 - 16^2)(27^4 + 27^2 \cdot 16^2 + 16^4) = (27 - 16)(27 + 16)(27^2 - 27 \cdot 16 + 16^2)(27^2 + 27 \cdot 16 + 16^2) = 11 \cdot 43 \cdot 553 \cdot 1417$. The remaining factorizations are motivated by the fact that $1001 = 7 \cdot 11 \cdot 13$. We see that $553 = 7 \cdot 79$ and $1417 = 13 \cdot 109$, so the answer is $43 + 79 + 109 = 231$.
